chunk_summary: Adds input validation to formatHeader and safeguards calculation in calculateRate.

comments.title: Consider trimming whitespace before check
comments.body: The check handles empty trimmed strings well, but consider documenting the fallback behavior.

comments.title: Potential zero-multiplication on negative amount
comments.body: Math.max(0, amount) clamps negative numbers to zero. If negative amounts should be rejected, consider throwing an error instead.
